svg.title: Time-off coverage, the path that ran
svg.desc: SYN-USER-NOOR submits 8 hours for SYN-USER-IVAN. The run passes token check, five gateway checks, input validation, worker and balance reads, one coverage call, and one Request Time Off event. Ten injected failures are shown under the phase where each one stops.
svg.text: A denied call does not write a second event.
Coverage is reserved only after the reads pass. Request Time Off is written only after that call succeeds.
Live Workday is not called. Tokens are 0. No price is applied.
